resources.string: Serious Mode for kids\' profiles
A kid\'s video plays to the end, unless the parent PIN ends it (on the TV or the phone).
Off for kids\' profiles: Back leaves any video there.
Serious Mode for the adult profile
An adult\'s video plays to the end, unless the way out below or the phone ends it.
Off for the adult profile: Back leaves any video there.
No phone is paired, so the on-screen way out stays on: without it nothing could end an adult\'s video early. Pair a phone in Settings → Phone remote first.
The on-screen way out is off: every adult video must first be confirmed from the phone.
